trace.content:
You write job advertisements for a South African recruitment platform. You receive a hiring brief and return one advertisement as structured JSON.

The only source of facts is the brief. This rule is absolute:
- Every statement about the employer, pay, benefits, location, work mode, team, reporting line, process, dates or legal status must appear in the brief. If the brief does not state it, leave the field empty. Never invent a benefit, a salary, a team size, a closing date, a contact, or an equity, privacy or accessibility statement.
- You may rephrase, reorder, split and tighten the brief's content. You may not add facts.
- If the brief is thin, write a shorter ad. A short true ad beats a long padded one.

Write for the candidate reading on a phone:
- Title: the plain occupation name, under 60 characters, no internal grade codes, no words like rockstar or ninja.
- 300–650 words in total. Sentences under 25 words. Short paragraphs; bullets for duties, requirements and benefits.
- Address the reader as "you". Never write "the ideal candidate", "the successful applicant" or "he/she".
- If the brief gives a purpose or success measures, use them to tell the reader what they will own and what good looks like. If a requirement carries "needed because", you may state that reason.
- Each responsibility bullet names a specific activity and its object, and where the brief allows, its scale, audience or how success is measured. Not "support the team"; rather "reconcile 40 supplier statements each month and resolve queries with buyers".
- Three to six must-have requirements, each one needed by a duty you listed. Everything else goes under nice-to-have. Do not add years-of-experience figures the brief did not give.
- If pay is given, state it exactly, with what determines placement in the range if the brief says so.
- Say who the person reports to and the team size only if the brief gives them. Say remote, hybrid or on-site only if the brief does.
- Plain language. No "fast-paced", "work hard play hard", "self-starter", "rockstar", "passionate", "competitive salary", "market-related".
- Neutral wording: avoid aggressive, dominant, competitive, fearless and similar masculine-coded adjectives; avoid "young", "energetic", "recent graduate", "native speaker", "able-bodied", age ranges, and anything about family status, religion or health. State a requirement only if the duties need it.
- Include the employer's equity, POPIA and accessibility statements verbatim when the brief provides them; otherwise leave those fields empty.
- Include application steps, closing date and contact only as given. If the brief says the ad is published on a job board with its own Apply button, leave the contact field empty.

Output: the JSON structure requested, with empty strings, 0 or "unspecified" for anything the brief does not provide.

Title: Regional Manager: Fleet
Company: Absa Group
About the company: Empowering Africa’s tomorrow, together…one story at a time. With over 100 years of rich history and strongly positioned as a local bank with regional and international expertise, a career with our family offers the opportunity to be part of this exciting growth journey, to reset our future and shape our destiny as a proudly African group.
Purpose of the role: To lead sustainable regional growth and protect the value of the existing customer portfolio through an equally weighted focus on business development and customer relationship management. The Regional Manager is accountable for new business acquisition, customer retention, increased share of wallet, revenue growth and profitability across the region. These outcomes are delivered through the leadership, coaching and performance management of a team of Business Development and Customer Relationship Consultants, supported by effective collaboration with internal product, credit, risk, operations and service teams. The role owns the regional customer lifecycle from prospecting and acquisition through onboarding, relationship deepening, service recovery, renewal and retention, positioning AVMS as the preferred fleet management and vehicle leasing partner.
Responsibilities (hiring manager's notes):
  - Translate the AVMS strategy into a regional sales and customer growth plan with clear segment, production, revenue and profitability priorities.
  - Build and maintain a balanced regional pipeline across Corporate, SME and Public Sector markets through proactive prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships.
  - Lead the team through the full sales lifecycle, including needs analysis, solution design, pricing, proposal development, negotiation, closure and implementation handover.
  - Achieve regional new business production, revenue, margin and market-share objectives within approved pricing, credit and risk parameters.
  - Own the health, retention and growth of the regional customer portfolio with the same level of focus as new business acquisition.
  - Implement a structured customer engagement model, including relationship plans, regular business reviews, service performance reviews and executive engagement for priority customers.
  - Identify and convert cross-sell, upsell, renewal and fleet expansion opportunities to increase customer share of wallet across AVMS products and value-added services.
  - Monitor customer satisfaction, complaints, service risks and early-warning indicators; coordinate timely service recovery and root-cause resolution to prevent attrition.
  - Maintain clear retention and growth plans for customers at risk, strategic accounts and high-potential portfolios.
  - Lead, coach and performance-manage a regional team of consultants accountable for acquisition, relationship management, retention and portfolio growth.
  - Allocate customer portfolios, prospects and regional opportunities to ensure clear ownership, appropriate capacity and balanced coverage.
  - Set individual and team targets and maintain a disciplined management rhythm covering pipeline, customer plans, renewals, service issues, wallet-growth opportunities and forecast accuracy.
  - Build capability in consultative selling, fleet and leasing solutions, commercial acumen, negotiation, customer engagement and service recovery.
  - Create a high-performance, customer-led culture with clear accountability, collaboration and succession planning.
  - Maintain a consolidated regional view of pipeline, portfolio performance, customer profitability, retention risk, wallet growth and service trends.
  - Use customer, operational and financial insights to prioritise interventions and implement corrective action where performance is below plan.
  - Ensure accurate forecasting, CRM discipline, management reporting and escalation of material commercial or customer risks.
  - Balance customer outcomes, commercial returns and risk when making regional decisions.
  - Coordinate Credit, Risk, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal and Customer Relations stakeholders to deliver integrated customer solutions and resolve regional delivery constraints.
  - Ensure seamless onboarding and implementation of new customers, with clear handover, service commitments and accountability.
  - Represent the voice of the customer in product, process and service-improvement forums and provide market intelligence to shape AVMS propositions.
  - Ensure adherence to Absa policies, sales governance, delegated authorities and applicable regulatory requirements.
  - Maintain complete and accurate approvals, customer records and deal documentation throughout the customer lifecycle.
  - Manage customer information in accordance with POPIA and relevant legislation and promptly escalate conduct, service, operational and reputational risks.
Must-have requirements:
  - Bachelors Degree and Professional Qualifications: Business, Commerce and Management Studies
Location: Johannesburg
Team notes: Leadership of a regional team of Business Development and Customer Relationship Consultants, collaborating with internal product, credit, risk, operations and service teams.
Employment equity statement: Absa is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from suitably qualified individuals from diverse backgrounds. In support of our Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) commitments and Employment Equity objectives, preference may be given to candidates from underrepresented designated groups, including persons with disabilities.
POPIA notice: Manage customer information in accordance with POPIA and relevant legislation and promptly escalate conduct, service, operational and reputational risks.
Accessibility statement: We encourage applicants who may require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process to let us know so that appropriate support can be provided.
Note: the ad will be published on a job board with its own Apply button.

• Ensure seamless onboarding and implementation of new customers, with clear handover, service commitments and accountability.
• Represent the voice of the customer in product, process and service-improvement forums, and provide market intelligence to shape AVMS propositions.

What you need
• A Bachelor's Degree and professional qualifications in Business, Commerce or Management Studies.
• Ability to lead, coach and performance-manage a regional sales and relationship team, because the regional targets are delivered through consultants.
